items.description:
Doodles Beachfront is a restaurant and function venue on the beachfront in Bloubergstrand, with panoramic views of Table Mountain and the bay. The sun sets beyond Robben Island, and the enclosed lower deck makes outdoor dining comfortable in all weather.

The menu includes an a la carte selection, a snack platter menu and a pensioners menu, along with an extensive wine list. The venue has live music, and the business says it offers set menus and platter options for private functions.

The kitchen serves breakfast, lunch, light meals and dinner, and the team says the setting, live music and service combine into a memorable evening.

It suits groups and families who want a lively meal with a view across the bay in Bloubergstrand.

items.description:
JEM Hair and Beauty Studio is a hair salon at 3-Arts Village on Main Road in Plumstead, Cape Town. Its team of more than 14 practitioners offers hair colouring, highlights, hair treatments and standard hair services, along with lash services, manicures, pedicures and nail services.

The studio also offers waxing, tinting, threading, basin treatments and a footlogix treatment. Its wash, cut and blow-dry packages are popular, and the business runs seasonal promotions. The salon is rated 4.9 out of five on Fresha from more than 6,600 reviews, and reviewers often mention the head massages and personal attention.

It suits clients who want a wide range of hair and beauty services in one visit at the Plumstead village centre.

items.description:
Kromboom Dental Centre is a dental practice in Rondebosch East, Cape Town, which describes its approach as patient first. Its services include consultations, child-friendly dentistry for patients aged 12 and under, wisdom tooth removal, and fixed and removable orthodontics for adults and children.

The practice offers advanced root canal treatment using a surgical microscope, Philips Zoom tooth whitening, and after-hours emergency care, and it says it uses state-of-the-art equipment. A full list of services is on its website.

The practice is contracted out of medical aid, so patients settle the bill after treatment and claim from their medical aid. Since March 2025 it has charged a small percentage above medical aid rates for most treatments, which is payable out of pocket.

items.description:
Las Paletas is a flavour-driven design studio in Killarney Gardens, Cape Town, which began as one of the city's first artisan ice cream brands around 2012. The studio now turns ice cream into immersive brand experiences that go beyond the product, translating a brand's theme and essence into a sensory moment for guests.

Its work covers fashion brands, sporting events, black-tie galas and brand activations, and the team says it will shape a bespoke experience from a brief. Sister brands include Flossy and Frose, Torch and Fluff, and La Colombiana.

The studio suits brands, event organisers and businesses that want a memorable, flavour-led experience in Cape Town.

items.description:
Mugg and Bean Paddocks is a branch of the Mugg and Bean coffee and dining chain, in Shops 19 and 20 at Paddocks Shopping Centre on Racecourse Road, Milnerton. The branch serves freshly brewed coffee, all-day breakfast, brunch, lunch, muffins and cakes made from scratch, along with bottomless drinks.

Guests can dine in, take away or order online, and the branch offers counter service, debit card payments and dessert. The branch describes itself as a place where customers become regulars and regulars become friends.

It suits families, friends and colleagues who want a relaxed breakfast, brunch or lunch at Paddocks Shopping Centre.

items.description:
The Old Cape Wine Shop is a boutique wine store on Imhoff Farm in Kommetjie, stocking a curated selection of South African wines from a wide range of regions, cultivars and terroirs. The shop describes its service as expertly selected wines with professional purchasing advice.

The shop knows the farms and winemakers personally, and nothing reaches the shelves without being tasted first. The range includes small-batch and boutique wineries, once-off winemakers' releases and wines sold on allocation, along with sparkling wine for celebrations.

The shop sits among the farm's newly planted vineyards, and it suits wine lovers who want personal guidance rather than an online cellar.

items.description:
Petworld XXL Diep River is a pet store at 89 Main Road in Diep River, part of the Petworld chain. The branch stocks dog food and treats, toys, health products, bowls and dispensers, beds and blankets, clothing, travel and safety items, and behaviour and training products.

The store also offers Groomworld grooming services, and the branch describes its team as expert and ready to help. In-store promotions run in a space that welcomes pets. The branch is one of several Petworld stores in the Cape Town area, including the Petworld XXL Somerset West and Express stores in Sea Point, Table Bay Mall and Rondebosch.

It suits dog owners in Diep River and the surrounding suburbs who want supplies, grooming and advice under one roof.

items.description:
The Thirsty Oyster Tavern is a seafood restaurant in the historic Old Harbour in Gordon's Bay. The business says it has grown over going on 24 years from a fisherman's pub into a well-patronised seafood restaurant, and its kitchen has been enlarged three times.

The restaurant has an enclosed entrance deck, a larger dining area and an upstairs deck with a view over False Bay and Table Mountain. Dishes are cooked from scratch, and there is live music on weekends.

It suits diners who want a relaxed seafood meal with harbour views and sunsets in Gordon's Bay. The tavern does not take email bookings, so guests are asked to book by phone.

items.description:
Walsh Fireplaces, trading as Victorian Fireplaces and Cape Chimneys, is a small fireplace company in Retreat, Cape Town, that makes bespoke fireplaces. Its main focus is traditional built-in fireplaces made from firebricks and the mantelpieces around them, along with Victorian and marble mantelpieces.

The company refurbishes and repairs Victorian fireplaces and their surrounds, and makes hearths from granite, slate, marble or sandstone. Fire grates and ironmongery are made to order so that they fit each fireplace, and it also supplies chimney pots, wrought-iron grates and parts for Victorian fireplaces.

It keeps firedogs, old-fashioned grates and Victorian fireplaces in stock and has a showroom where customers can view samples. It suits homeowners who want a bespoke or period fireplace.
